description.value: Salt Pizzeria is an artisanal pizzeria on Vancouver Island billing itself as BC's #1-rated pizza, building every pie on aged sourdough made from 100% organic flour with freshly sourced toppings. Beyond pizza they serve Salt Spring Island gelato, dairy-free sorbet, and in-house or to-go beer, wine, and cider. A 'half-baked' take-and-bake option lets touring cyclists pick up a pizza and finish it wherever they're staying.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides the primary evidence. The address in the website body and footer consistently shows '201-891 Island Hwy W, Parksville, BC' with phone (250) 586-2121, confirming the OSM unit number. The FAQ explicitly states no gluten-free options are available, confirms vegan cheese substitutions, and the e-transfer/pickup pages confirm curb-side takeout. No bike parking, washroom, water, or Wi-Fi information appears anywhere on the site. A notable internal inconsistency exists: the website's top-of-page banner header shows '897 Island Hwy W' and different hours than the body/footer, which consistently shows '891 Island Hwy W' and Wed–Sat hours; the body/footer is treated as authoritative since it is repeated across all subpages.
concerns: Internal website inconsistency: the persistent top-of-page banner shows '897 Island Hwy W' and 'Open Thursday to Sunday 3:00PM to 8:30PM', while the body and footer on every subpage show '201-891 Island Hwy W' and Wed–Sat noon hours. The body/footer version is treated as current but the discrepancy should be verified.
OSM opening_hours (Mo, We-Fr, Su 15:00-20:00) differ substantially from the website hours (Wed–Thu 12–7, Fri–Sat 12–8, closed Sun–Tue); OSM hours appear outdated.
OSM address field contains only 'Parksville' with no street — the full street address (891 Island Hwy W) was sourced from the website, not OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Parksville with a current website and confirmed operating hours; straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: FAQ confirms vegetarian pizzas available; vegan options offered via two vegan cheese substitutes (crushed cashew/nutritional yeast blend or Violife Vegan Mozzarella). FAQ explicitly states no gluten-free options
